a1.cap: Create a reusable StarRatingComponent that receives the current rating (required) and max (default 5) from its parent, renders clickable stars, and emits rated with the chosen value.

a1.cap: Signal inputs (input(), input.required()) receive data from the parent and are read like signals. output() creates an event the parent listens to with ( ) binding.

a1.cap: Data flows down through inputs and events flow up through outputs, which keeps components reusable.
